description: Western Province - The review on the Administrative Reports and the Income & Expenditure Reports of the Urban Councils, Kolonnawa, Maharagama, Kesbewa, Boralesgamuwa and Seethawakapura of Colombo District and Wattala-Mabola, Minuwangoda, Ja-Ela, Katunayake - Seeduwa adn Peliyagoda of Gampaha District and Panadura, Horana, Kalutara and Beruwala of Kalutara District for the year 2014
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the administration and financial reporting of a local government body (Urban Council Kolonnawa). It details public service matters such as council meetings, employee salaries, maintenance of assets, income and expenditure accounts, auditing, and service provision (e.g., garbage collection, crematorium operations). While it mentions a government official (Chandrani Samarakoon), it does so in the context of her administrative role in presenting these public service reports, not in the context of a personnel appointment or government restructuring. The content fits the definition of Public Service Gazettes, which cover public sector administration, service conditions, and administrative reports.
